book.name: Joŋ
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Joŋ gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso chugɛ bikaa bi booŋ be ba ŋgoo

Gɛ̀ bee akfuuŋ bude ayuu mo nyu Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe, Jiso kɛɛ lɛ kife kì wu lé wu chînɛ woŋ kfunɛ le, wu kaasɛ wu gɛɛŋ fɛ Chiji le, le ki kojɛ ka. No wu gɛ̀ koŋe bamii ba gɛ̀ bee be yi woŋ kfunɛ le, wu koŋ bo wu gɛɛŋ wu mɛsɛ.
No bo gɛ̀ jii mwɛɛ fɛnfu, debele nyu wu leesɛ wa ŋkwajɛ a fitele fì Juda wù mwa Samoŋ Ɛkaliot le lɛ wu gêsɛ Jiso.
No Jiso gɛ̀ kee lɛ Chiji le wu nya wa mwɛɛ munchii chiaaŋ ye le, bɛ lɛ wu gɛ̀ ja fɛ Nyo le, wù nyu wu kaasɛ wu tu jiŋ fɛ Nyo le,
wu mo wu ja we a mwɛɛ munjile, wu baayɛ bikuŋ bie, wu jo nju yi ba shode ye yu, wu kaaŋ chiŋ,
wu mo wu chvu joo a ŋkaa le, wu kɛ wu chuge bikaa bi booŋ be ba ŋgoo yu, wu shode bɛ nju yi wu gɛ̀ shulɛ chiŋ yɛɛ.
No wu gɛ̀ chuge lɛ wu to wu bu fɛ Samoŋ Bita le, wu biih wu le lɛ, “Tada, lé chûgɛ wo bikaa biaŋ?”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ fiɛɛ fì ŋgee taŋlo wo kɛɛ mɛɛse gɛ. Wo lé wo gê wo kɛ̂ɛ nyu ajiŋ.”

content: Bita jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Gɛ taŋlo wo yu wo chugɛ bikaa biaŋ gɛ.” Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ mbaaŋ wo chugɛ gɛ, tu gɛ wo kɛme fiɛɛ bɛ mɛ gɛ.”

content: Samoŋ Bita mo wu jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Tada, finɛ le noo, tu gɛ wo nyu wo chugɛ gɛh nyu bikaa biaŋ maa gɛ. Wo lé wo chûgɛ tɛ chiaaŋ yaŋ bɛ kikwɛɛ kaŋ fo.”
Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wù chugɛ wa ye le wu yuu wa ye yichii, gɛ wo kɛme ki wu ka wu chûgɛ ye fede bikaa gɛ. Bɛŋ le bɛŋ yuude wa, geenɛ gɛ nyu bɛŋ bachii ba yuude gɛ.”

content: Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme noo nje wu gɛ̀ kɛɛ wa muh wu lé wu gê wu gêsɛ wu. Le fiɛɛ fì wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ, “Gɛ bɛŋ yuude bachii gɛ.”
Jiso gɛ̀ mɛsɛ wu chugɛ bikaa biboo, wu noŋ bikuŋ bie ye le, wu kaasɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu tu fɛ kijusɛ ke le, wu mo wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ le bɛŋ kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì ŋge fɛ bɛŋ le finɛ?
Bɛŋ tɛŋe mɛ lɛ Muh wu N'yɛyɛ bɛŋ ka tɛŋe lɛ Tada, bɛŋ tɛŋe nyu chuule noo nje le fiɛɛ fì nle fi.
Nɛ le lɛ le mɛ wù Tada wene ŋka nyume Muh wene wu N'yɛyɛ wu le wu chugɛ bikaa biɛna, tu bɛŋ tɛ kɛme ki bɛŋ chûge bikaa bi muh lɛ muh.
Ŋge noo ki ndunyɛ bɛŋ le lɛ bɛŋ gêe tɛ no ŋge fɛ bɛŋ le.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ gɛ mwa wu lɛme to wu kuge wu fede chiji wu lɛme gɛ, gɛ̀ muh wù ba tuŋ lo to wu kuge tɛ wu fede muh wù tuŋ wu gɛ.
Bɛŋ nɛ kee mwɛɛ munɛ, bɛŋ gee mu, njoŋ wù baaŋ nyû wene.

Gɛ njɛme nyu kune bɛŋ bachii gɛ. Ŋkee bamii ba nle ncha. Geenɛ, fi le lɛ fiɛɛ fì le a Ŋwa wu Nyo le fi kɛme ki fi to fi kojɛ no ba gɛ̀ saŋ lɛ, ‘Muh wù jii mwɛɛ munjile mwaŋ le wu ja wu bii bikaa biaŋ le.’
Nsɛŋe fiɛɛ finɛ bɛŋ le mɛɛse fi nyu fi ge fi kooshɛ, fi le lɛ fi doo fi kooshɛ, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ bɛɛŋ lɛ le mɛ wuyu kibɛɛ.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ muh wù le wu fi mo muh wù la wù ntuŋ, tu wu fi nyume mɛ. Muh wù fi mɛ tu wu fi nyu muh wù tuŋ mɛ.”

content: Jiso dunyɛ muh wù lé wu gêsɛ wu
No Jiso jɛmɛ mwɛɛ munɛ nɛ, fitele ja fi tu fi fuuŋse wu. Wu ja wu jɛmɛ chaaŋ wu du lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ muh mu bɛŋ le, lé wu gê wu gêsɛ mɛ.”

content: Booŋ be ba ŋgoo ja bo tu bo jiiŋe ye yiboo bo maŋe laa wu jɛme nyu muh wù la lɛ.
Muh mu ŋgoo yi booŋ ba Jiso le wù Jiso gɛ̀ koŋe, gɛ̀ yɛmɛ wu jii mwɛɛ mbebe ye le.
Samoŋ Bita ŋwalɛ wu, wu jɛmɛ lɛ wu bîih Jiso le laa, wu jɛme nyu yɛɛŋ la.
Noo, wu yɛɛŋ wu gɛɛŋ yi Jiso le wu biih wu le lɛ, “Tada, le yɛɛŋ?”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Le muh wù nlé bwɛ̂ɛdɛ blɛd nchu a joo yi mbaa le nya wu le.”

content: Noo, wu mo wu chu blɛd a joo yi mbaa le wu nya Juda wù mwa Samoŋ Ɛkaliot le.
Gɛh no Juda fi blɛd wɛɛ nɛ, Sataŋ mo wu lee yi ye ye le. Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Yâŋsɛ gê fiɛɛ fì wo goone ki wo gê.”

content: Muh mu ŋgoo yiboo le gɛ̀ baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme wu le noo gɛ.
Bamu gɛ̀ kwaji lɛ no Juda gɛ̀ bee muh wù gɛɛde kikɛɛ, lɛ Jiso jɛme wu le lɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu gu mwɛɛ mù bo goone ki bo ji Ŋka yu, kɛnɛ lɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu nya fiɛɛ bamii ba fuude le.
No Juda fi blɛd wɛɛ noo wu ji, wu mo wu bu lo kimimia wu gɛɛŋ. Sege kɛɛ gɛ̀ bee wa antaŋ.
Jiso tee kwe booŋ be ba ŋgoo le
No Juda bu wu gɛɛŋ noo, Jiso shɛɛ wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Mɛɛse bo lé bo kɛ̂ bo yɛ̂de bvukugɛ bvu muh wù jee che le Mwamuh le, bo mo bo yɛde tɛ bvukugɛ bvù le bvu Nyo yi ye ye le.
Nɛ bo yɛŋ bvukugɛ bvu Nyo yi ye ye le, tu Nyo lé wu dûnyɛ tɛ bvukugɛ bvu Mwa ye yi wu wù Nyo le. Wu lé wu dûnyɛ lo kimimia.
Booŋ baŋ, nlé nyû besabɛŋ yi kife le nɛ shige. Bɛŋ lé bɛŋ shɛ̂ɛ bɛŋ gôoŋ mɛ bɛŋ gɛ yɛ̂ŋ gɛ. No ŋgɛ njɛmɛ Bajuu le, le no njɛme bɛŋ le mɛɛse lɛ, ‘Fɛ ŋgɛɛne fo gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ to fo gɛ.’
Nyaa nchi bɛŋ le, nyu nchi wu fwɛŋ lɛ bɛŋ doo bɛŋ shɛɛ bɛŋ kôŋe ye yene. Bɛŋ kôŋe gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no ŋkoŋe bɛŋ.
Nɛ bɛŋ le bɛŋ shɛɛ bɛŋ kɛme kiŋkoŋɛ noo, finɛ fiɛɛ ge bamii bachii mo bo kee lɛ bɛŋ le booŋ baŋ ba ŋgoo.”

content: Jiso jɛmɛ lɛ Bita lé wu gê wu fâŋ wu
Samoŋ Bita mo wu biih Jiso le lɛ, “Tada, wo gɛɛne nyu faaŋ?” Jiso chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Fɛ ŋgɛɛne fo gɛ taŋlo wo bi mɛne mɛɛse gɛ. Wo lé wo shɛ̂ɛ fɛ wo bi.”

content: Bita kaasɛ wu biih wu le lɛ, “Tada, gɛ taŋlo mbii wo le mɛɛse gɛ nje la? Nlé nnyâ kinche kaŋ ki ŋkwe nje wo.”
Jiso biih wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo taŋlo wo nyâ kinche kuŋ ki wo kwê nje mɛ? Nsɛŋe wo nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ nyishii lé yi gê yi tôŋ a wo faŋ wa mɛ kiŋgane kintɛde.”

footnotes.text: Ki ba shii ba jii mwɛɛ Bajuu to bo shii fɛkuu bo yɛɛŋ lo kimbe kimimia fɛ bo jii.
